properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-media-upload' | SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-metadata-preparation' | SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-metadata-upload' | filter @message like "Finished preparing with source"
| parse @message "Finished preparing with source *, traceId: *, tenant: *, tenantName: , voice count: , screen count: ," 
 as source,traceId,tenantId,tenantName,voiceCount,screenCount
| stats
 count() as EntryCount
 by tenantId as Tenant ID, tenantName as Tenant Name
properties.title: Media Upload Source Preparation

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-livevox-unzip-file' | filter @message like ", file type received:"
| parse @message "🔍tenant id: , file type received: " as tenantId, fileType
| stats
 sum(if( trim(fileType) = "mp3", 1, 0)) as Voice Count (MP3),
 sum(if( trim(fileType) = "csv", 1, 0)) as Metadata Count (CSV),
 sum(if( trim(fileType) = "webm", 1, 0)) as Screen Count (WEBM),
 sum(if( trim(fileType) not in [ "mp3", "csv", "webm"], 1, 0)) as Invalid Types Count,
 count() as Total_Files,
 (100 * (Total_Files - sum(if( trim(fileType) not in [ "mp3", "csv", "webm"], 1, 0))) / Total_Files) as Success_Percentage
 by tenantId
properties.title: Unzip files

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-livevox-unzip-file' | filter @message like "Error in lambdaHandler,"
| parse @message "tenantId:, jobId:, with error" as tenantId,jobId,error
| stats count() as count by tenantId, error
properties.title: Unzip errors

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-media-upload' | SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-metadata-preparation' | SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-metadata-upload' | filter



 @message like "Received segment with source"



 or @message like "Segment failed with source"



 or @message like "Failed to upload segmentMetadata with source"



 or @message like "Successfully uploaded media with source"



 or @message like "Failed to upload media with source"



| parse @message "Received segment with source *, traceId: *,tenant: *, tenantName: *, voice count: *, screen count: *" as prepareInputsource, prepareInputTraceId,prepareInputTenantId,prepareInputTenantName, prepareInputVoiceCount, prepareInputScreenCount
| parse @message "Segment failed with source *, traceId: *, tenant: *, tenantName: *, voice count: *, screen count: *" as preparedFailureSource,preparedSuccessTraceId,preparedFailureTenatId,preparedFailureTenatName,prepareFailureVoiceCount, prepareFailureScreenCount
| parse @message "Failed to upload segmentMetadata with source *, traceId: *, tenant: , tenantName: , voice count:, screen count:" as metadataFailureSource,metadataInputTraceId,metadataFailureTenantId,metadataFailureTenantName,metadataFailureVoiceCount, metadataFailureScreenCount
| parse @message "Successfully uploaded media with source *, traceId: *, tenant: *, tenantName: *, voice count: *, screen count: *" as mediaSuccessSource,mediaSuccessTraceId,mediaSuccessTenantId,mediaSuccessTenantName,mediaSuccessVoiceCount,mediaSuccessScreenCount
| parse @message "Failed to upload media with source *, traceId: *,tenant: *, tenantName: *, voice count: *, screen count: *" as mediaFailureMediaSource,mediaFailureTraceId,mediaFailureTenantId,mediaFailureTenantName,mediaFailureVoiceCount,mediaFailureScreenCount
| stats



 floor(coalesce(sum(prepareInputVoiceCount),0)) as Input Voice Count,



 floor(coalesce(sum(mediaSuccessVoiceCount),0)) as Output Voice Count,



 floor(coalesce(sum(prepareInputScreenCount),0)) as Input Screen Count,



 floor(coalesce(sum(mediaSuccessScreenCount),0)) as Output Screen Count,



 floor(coalesce(sum(prepareFailureVoiceCount),0)

+ coalesce(sum(metadataFailureVoiceCount),0) + coalesce(sum(mediaFailureVoiceCount),0)) as Total Voice Failure Count,



 floor(coalesce(sum(prepareFailureScreenCount),0)

+ coalesce(sum(metadataFailureScreenCount),0) + coalesce(sum(mediaFailureScreenCount),0)) as Total Screen Failure Count,



 round(100 * (coalesce(sum(mediaSuccessVoiceCount),0))

/ (coalesce(sum(prepareInputVoiceCount),0) + (coalesce(sum(prepareInputVoiceCount),0) = 0)), 2) as Voice Success Rate (%),



 round(100 * (coalesce(sum(mediaSuccessScreenCount),0))

/ (coalesce(sum(prepareInputScreenCount),0) + (coalesce(sum(prepareInputScreenCount),0) = 0)), 2) as Screen Success Rate (%)



 by

coalesce(prepareInputTenantId,preparedSuccessTenantId,preparedFailureTenatId,mediaInputTenantId,mediaSuccessTenantId,mediaFailureTenantId
 metadataInputTenantId, metadataSuccessTenantId, metadataFailureTenantId) as
Tenant ID, 

coalesce(prepareInputTraceId, preparedSuccessTraceId, preparedFailureTraceId, metadataInputTraceId, metadataSuccessTraceId, metadataFailureTraceId, mediaInputTraceId, mediaSuccessTraceId, mediaFailureTraceId) as Trace ID



 | sort Tenant ID asc
properties.title: Media upload summary and errors

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-media-upload' | filter @message like /Successfully uploaded media/
| parse @message "Successfully uploaded media with source *, traceId: *, tenant: *, tenantName: *, voice count: *, screen count: , segmentId: , SLA time in milliseconds: " as Source, TraceId, TenantId, TenantName, Vcount, Scount, segment, slaInMillis 
| stats avg(slaInMillis) / 60000 as Average_SLA_Minutes by TenantId, TenantName, Source
| display Source, TenantId, TenantName, Average_SLA_Minutes, concat(round((Average_SLA_Minutes / 60 * 100), 0), "%") as Relative_to_target_SLA_1_hr
| sort TenantId, TenantName, Source
properties.title: Tenants SLA

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/production-rec-lambda-snf-input-preprocessing' | SOURCE '/aws/vendedlogs/states/production-rec-state-machine-snf-media-uploader' | filter ((details.resource like /putMetricData/ and type like /TaskScheduled/) or @message like /Preprocessing completed successfully\./) 
| parse details.parameters '"Name":"Tenant","Value":""' as tenantId1 
| parse details.parameters '"Name":"Source","Value":""' as source1 
| parse details.parameters '"MetricName":"smart-reach-output-segment-count","Value":}' as outputSegmentsMetrics 
| parse @message "Preprocessing completed successfully. tenantId: *, source: *, segmentsCount: *" as tenantId2, source2, segmentsCount 
| stats sum(segmentsCount) as inputSegments, 
 sum(outputSegmentsMetrics) as outputSegments, 
 concat(round(coalesce(sum(outputSegmentsMetrics) / sum(segmentsCount), 0)*100), '%') as successRate 
 by coalesce(tenantId1, tenantId2) as tenantId, coalesce(source1, source2) as source
properties.title: Metadata Processing Progress
